title: macro_ir_reliability: likelihood and information diagnostics for macroscopic ion-channel currents

creators.name: Moffatt, Luciano
creators.affiliation: Instituto de Química Física de los Materiales, Medio Ambiente y Energía (INQUIMAE), CONICET, Universidad de Buenos Aires

description:
C++20 engine for the likelihood of macroscopic ion-channel current recordings under the MacroIR family of algorithms, together with the run scripts and the R notebooks that produced the figures of Likelihood approximations distort the ion channel kinetic information in macroscopic currents.

The simulation output the figures are drawn from is too large to live here and is deposited separately: 10.5281/zenodo.22167744. Most of it cannot be regenerated, because the production lanes drew their random seed from the system entropy source and never recorded it; the data record is the only copy.

provenance/ carries the three source files that differ across the four code states used over the campaign, and maps the directory names in the data record to the commits that wrote them. See the README for how to build, how to run a .macroir program, and the order the figure notebooks must be rendered in.
